Package com.mimecast.robin.endpoints

Class MailProxyAuthHandler

java.lang.Object
com.mimecast.robin.endpoints.MailProxyAuthHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ApiHandler
public class MailProxyAuthHandler extends Object implements ApiHandler
Handler for the /mail/proxy-auth endpoint.

Implements the nginx mail proxy auth_http protocol so an nginx IMAP/POP3 proxy can sit in front of a mailbox server that does not resolve aliases itself. The login is resolved the same way the bundled Dovecot passdb does it: an exact user match first, then an alias or auto alias that points at an existing user. The password is verified against the canonical user and nginx is told to log in to the configured backend as that canonical user.

Request headers (sent by nginx): Auth-Method, Auth-User, Auth-Pass, Auth-Protocol, Client-IP. Response headers: Auth-Status, and on success Auth-Server, Auth-Port and Auth-User; on failure Auth-Wait.

The endpoint is disabled unless proxyAuth.enabled is set in dovecot.json5 and requires the SQL authentication backend.

    • resolve

      static Optional<String> resolve(MailProxyAuthHandler.Directory directory, String login)
      Resolves a login to a canonical mailbox user.

      Exact user match wins; otherwise the alias or auto alias destination is used if it is an existing user.

      Parameters:
      directory - User directory.
      login - Lower-cased login.
      Returns:
      Canonical user address, or empty when the login does not map to a mailbox user.
